breakdown.description: The prompt assumes equal span implies equal force sharing, but the load split in parallel bars depends on the relative axial stiffnesses AE/L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly avoids splitting the load equally between the bars. Instead, it instructs solving a system of equations using both equilibrium (P1 + P2 = 30000 N) and compatibility (δ1 = δ2) conditions, which properly accounts for load distribution based on relative axial stiffnesses AE/L. This matches the ground truth approach.

breakdown.description: The prompt adds the two bar elongations to get the plate displacement, even though parallel bars between rigid plates undergo the same elongation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states that both bars undergo identical elongation (compatibility condition δ1 = δ2) and instructs calculating 'the common elongation using δ = PL/(EA) for either bar' — not by adding the two elongations together. This correctly reflects that parallel bars between rigid plates share the same elongation, matching the ground truth.
